description:
EARLY - please be careful about using this in a real project yet.

      What is verified: the package installs, its nodes appear in the NodeBrowser, and 95
      tests cover the geometry, projection, serialization, tile indexing and mesh
      arithmetic on every push. Three help patches exercise the same paths inside vvvv.
      What is NOT verified: tile fetching over the network is covered by one manual run
      rather than by tests, and plenty of nodes have still never been executed. Node names
      and categories will change between releases. Bug reports and PRs welcome.

      Geographic Information System (GIS) library for vvvv gamma.

      Provides nodes for:
      - GIS.Geometry: create and manipulate Points, Lines, Polygons (NetTopologySuite)
      - GIS.Projection: reproject between CRS (ProjNet; EPSG:4326, EPSG:3857, UTM)
      - GIS.Serialization: parse/write WKT, WKB, GeoJSON
      - GIS.Tiles: fetch map tiles from OSM and XYZ sources (BruTile)
      - GIS.Mesh: local coordinates, polygon tessellation, heightmaps

      Requires vvvv gamma 7.2 or newer (.NET 8).
releaseNotes:
0.2.0-alpha - GIS.Tiles was unusable in 0.1.0-alpha. Please upgrade.

      If you fetched a tile with 0.1.0-alpha, vvvv deadlocked: FetchTileBytes awaited on the
      calling thread and blocked on the result, and vvvv's runtime thread carries a
      SynchronizationContext, so the continuation was posted back to the thread waiting for
      it. The runtime stopped evaluating, F5 could not restart it, and closing the window
      left vvvv.exe running. Fixed.

      Also fixed, all of them silent:
      - the tile source factories returned ITileSource while every fetch node takes
        IHttpTileSource, so in a patch the two pins simply would not connect. The whole
        GIS.Tiles category was decorative. BREAKING: the factories now return
        IHttpTileSource.
      - OsmTileSource passed no attribution to BruTile, so TileAttribution returned an empty
        string - while the OSM tile usage policy requires attribution to be displayed and the
        README points at that node as the way to get it. OSM and OpenTopoMap now declare
        theirs, and XyzTileSource takes attributionText / attributionUrl.
      - ReprojectGeometry returned geometry holding target-CRS coordinates while still
        declaring the source CRS. Right numbers, wrong label, and its sibling
        ReprojectPointGeometry had always set it correctly, so which node you picked decided
        whether your data was labelled.
      - BREAKING: WmtsTileSource is removed. Its entire body threw NotSupportedException,
        because BruTile 6.0 dropped the parser it was written against, while the README and
        this description both advertised WMTS support. Use XyzTileSource with a WMTS GetTile
        URL template.

      New: TileIndexParts splits a TileIndex into column, row and level, and
      CoordinateSystemInfo reports a CRS's name, authority, EPSG code and WKT. Both exist
      because those values are opaque inside a patch - an IOBox shows only the type name -
      so there was no way to confirm which tile you were requesting or which CRS you had
      built.

      Also new: 95 tests, run on every push and before every publish, including a regression
      test for the deadlock that uses a single-threaded SynchronizationContext and no
      network. And three help patches, where there were none.

      0.1.0-alpha - First release whose nodes actually appear in vvvv.

      The 0.0.x line (0.0.1 - 0.0.4, now unlisted) installed and contributed no nodes at
      all, for three independent reasons, none of which produced an error message:
      malformed document IDs in VL.GIS.vl (VL requires exactly 22 characters, first in
      [A-V]); a missing UTF-8 BOM; and no [assembly: ImportAsIs] on the forwarded
      assemblies, without which their public statics are demoted to raw .NET reflection
      nodes that the NodeBrowser hides.

      The entry point is now generated rather than hand-written, and all three failure
      modes are asserted before release.

      Also in this release: node categories are GIS.Geometry / GIS.Projection /
      GIS.Serialization / GIS.Tiles / GIS.Mesh.*; VL.GIS.Stride is renamed VL.GIS.Mesh
      since it never referenced Stride; minimum vvvv version is now gamma 7.2.

      The GIS functionality itself remains essentially untested - see the README.
summary: GIS geometry, projection, serialization, map tiles and mesh nodes for vvvv gamma.
title: VL.GIS — GIS Library for vvvv gamma
